name: Ghostarchive (search pages)
tier_rationale: Anonymous operator without a recorded legal entity, terms or privacy policy (A8 unknown); P083 lists 'unknown - CrawlGraph, Ghostarchive, WebTechSurvey' (P060's module tier trusted is not a statement about this provider).

reliability.justification: Anonymous archive operator: captures cannot be checked against an accountable operator, so reliability cannot be judged.

search.title: Ghostarchive search pages search?term= (read only)

terms.quote: Every link host has a provider-registry entry with tier and rationale (A8); unknown-tier hosts get the 'unknown operator' badge and their templates take IOC_TYPES values only (A8 BR4): never PERSONAL_TYPES, CNPJ, company names, keywords, malware or actor names, or other free text (P311 lint).

search.notes: Quote: binding council text (P083 cond 4). Class 'open' is the P060/P083 chair-file class (search pages, read only). ghostarchive.org/search?term= (research C0196, verified): 'unknown operator' badge, IOC_TYPES values only. P060 drops ghostarchive from archive_mining's hosts (its URL lists reach it through the graph), so in this build only the manual link uses it. The archive/submit function is never used (it would fetch and publish the target, rule 7).

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G01-3, p2-G14-1: batches only extend it (ghostarchive__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Flags all false because no submission path exists. archive_mining (default off) and the links carry the 'unknown operator' badge.
